# Pressure_Threshold_Logic

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A logic mechanism where the switching of hysterons is governed by pressure differentials exceeding critical thresholds, enabling nonlinear decision-making in the flow network. Offers a physical analog of threshold logic units, potentially enabling energy-efficient, in-network computation in TCC systems.
